eval.description: Anthropic internal automated tasks where a model must autonomously do self-contained ML and alignment research. Tasks are scaled-down versions of Anthropic research work and training materials. Scored with a weighted average of objective, outcome-based task scores; cards use a conservative rule-out threshold of 0.6 for AI R&D-4. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents do self-contained machine learning and alignment research tasks without human help.

versions.changes: Weighted-average suite as reported from Claude Sonnet 3.7 onward, with a 0.6 AI R&D-4 rule-out threshold.

scores.description: Outcome-based score on one Suite 2 research task (partial credit allowed).

metrics.description: Weighted average over Suite 2 task scores. Weights reflect task quality and coverage of Anthropic research skills. Cards treat scores below 0.6 as ruling out AI R&D-4.
